init_SawyerNutDisassembleEnvV2: create a SawyerNutDisassembleEnvV2 environment instance with hand and object initialization bounds for the peg disassembly task
evaluate_state: evaluate the robot state by computing reward and success info from observations and actions
compute_reward: compute the disassembly reward combining grasp, orientation, and placement components with success override
reset_model: reset the simulation model by repositioning the peg, wrench, and hand to initial or randomized positions
reward_quat: compute the orientation reward by comparing the wrench quaternion against the ideal laid-down target quaternion
